item.title: What Are Joins in Azure SQL Database
item.description: Joins play a crucial role in combining data from multiple tables in a relational database. This article delves into the concept of joins in Azure SQL Database, covering their types, syntax, and providing practical examples for effective data retrieval. 1. Types of Joins: Inner Join: An inner join returns only the rows that have matching values in both tables. It filters out the rows with no corresponding values in the joined table.

item.title: What Is the Difference Between INNER JOIN and OUTER JOIN in SQL
item.description: In SQL, JOIN operations are fundamental for combining data from multiple tables. Two common types of JOINs are INNER JOIN and OUTER JOIN. This article explores the differences between INNER JOIN and OUTER JOIN, covering their use cases, syntax, and providing practical examples. 1. INNER JOIN: An INNER JOIN returns only the rows where there is a match in both tables. It filters out rows with no corresponding values in the joined table.
